verdict.rationale: Cognee says you can run the full memory engine, UI and pipelines on your own machine or stack (open source, Docker image, no account required). That lets a user decide where data physically lives. However, nothing documents region or residency selection for Cognee Cloud; residency control comes only from self-hosting. Missing for 10: region selection for Cognee Cloud, documented data-residency guarantees or policy, independent corroboration.
